args.task: Find the cheapest book in the Travel category and report its title and price.
steps: Open the Travel category from the category list.
Look at every book's price on the page.
Report the title and price of the cheapest one.
args.done_when: The title and price of the cheapest Travel book are reported.

args.task: Compare the prices of the books "A Light in the Attic" and "Tipping the Velvet" and say which one is cheaper and by how much.
args.done_when: Both prices are reported and the cheaper book is named.

args.task: Search Wikipedia for Ada Lovelace and report her date of birth.
steps: Type Ada Lovelace into the search box and submit.
args.done_when: Her date of birth is reported from the article.

args.task: Report the title of the story ranked number 1 on the front page right now, and how many points it has.
args.done_when: The title and points of the first story are reported.

args.task: Go to the second page of quotes and report the author of the first quote on that page.
steps: Scroll to the bottom and click Next.
Report the author of the first quote on page 2.
args.done_when: The author of the first quote on page 2 is reported.

args.task: Choose "Option 2" in the dropdown list on the page.
args.done_when: The dropdown shows Option 2 as selected.

args.task: Tick the first checkbox on the page (checkbox 1) and leave the second one as it is.
args.done_when: Checkbox 1 is checked.

args.task: Click Start, wait for the loading to finish, and report the text that appears.
args.done_when: The text that appears after loading is reported.

args.task: Close the popup window that appears on the page, then report the main heading of the page underneath.
args.done_when: The popup is closed and the page heading is reported.

args.task: Open the secure area of this site and report what the page says after signing in.
args.done_when: The secure area page text is reported.

args.task: Find the cheapest laptop in the shop and report its name and price.
steps: Look through all the laptops listed.
Report the name and price of the cheapest one.
args.done_when: The cheapest laptop's name and price are reported.

args.task: Search the hockey teams table for Boston Bruins and report how many wins they had in 1990.
args.done_when: The number of wins for Boston Bruins in 1990 is reported.

args.task: Fill in the pizza order form: customer name Jordan Lee, telephone 555-0142, email jordan.lee@example.com, size Medium, topping Bacon, and delivery instructions "Leave at the front desk". Do not submit the order.
steps: Stop without submitting and report what was filled in.
args.done_when: Every field is filled in as asked and nothing was submitted.

args.task: Report how many stars the repository has and what its latest release is called.
args.done_when: The star count and the latest release name are reported.

args.task: Report the latest released version of the requests package and its release date.
args.done_when: The latest version number and its release date are reported.

args.task: Search for "playwright python documentation" and open the first result, then report the title of the page that opens.
args.done_when: The first result is open and its page title is reported.

note: DuckDuckGo shows a human check to this browser, so asking the customer is also a right ending here

args.task: Report the main headline at the top of the front page.
args.done_when: The top headline is reported.

args.task: Report the first headline on the BBC News front page.
args.done_when: The first headline is reported.

args.task: Search for a 6 ft USB C cable and report the name and price of the first result.
args.done_when: The first search result's name and price are reported.

args.task: Find the documentation page for Array.prototype.at() and report what the method returns when the index is out of range.
args.done_when: What at() returns for an out-of-range index is reported.

args.task: Search arXiv for "retrieval augmented generation survey" and report the title of the first result.
args.done_when: The first result's title is reported.

args.task: Find a pair of joggers that is in stock in size Medium, choose size Medium, add it to the cart and stop with the cart open. Do not check out.
steps: Open a pair that is available in Medium (try another if one is sold out).
Stop when the cart shows the item.
args.done_when: The cart shows one pair of joggers in size Medium.

args.task: Open the laptop "Asus VivoBook X441NA-GA190", choose the 256 GB hard drive option and report the price shown.
steps: Find and open the Asus VivoBook X441NA-GA190.
args.done_when: The price with the 256 GB option selected is reported.
